reason: Museum's only enumerable machine-readable source is the FlowWorks 'FlowCenter' DAM behind a proprietary, aggressively rate-limited WebSocket (wss://sammlungen.deutsche-kinemathek.de/flws/socket, felib protocol; envelope {action,params}; works unauthenticated). That catalogue is the film-DISTRIBUTION index ('~20,000 distributable film holdings' for cinemas/festivals per the museum's own sammlung-digital page) = overwhelmingly MOVING-IMAGE title records (records carry filmspeed/cans/materialtype/colour/sound/borndigital and video duration/fps/videocodec). In-scope FLAT film art is sparse and mostly un-digitized there: full-text searches for Plakat/Filmplakat/Fotografie/Standfoto/Kostuementwurf/Szenenbild/Zeichnung each returned 0-1 hits, and nearly every record has media:[]/mainthumbnail:null. The genuine flat-art collections (Marlene Dietrich 350 posters/drawings/paintings; Josef Fenneker film posters; Ken Adam set designs) are presented only as static editorial microsites / Drupal gallery pages (e.g. /kaenguruh/ is a Create-React-App SPA over the same throttled WS; Fenneker page = hand-placed Drupal /system/files/styles/ teaser images under /private/) with NO enumerable per-object API; the full DAM (/flow2/) is login-gated. Image download IS technically possible (mfc/thumbnail.cgi resizer delivered a 1200x719 JPEG; master TIF 8859x5316@600dpi is range-downloadable) but there is no in-scope flat-art corpus to enumerate, and the WS is operationally unreliable (~90% query timeouts even after cooldown), so a resumable multi-thousand-record scrape is not feasible. Fails the film-museum scope gate (moving-image catalogue + flat art locked behind editorial pages/login).
easy_source_found: No OA/open-data API. /opendata,/api,/developers = 404; data.deutsche-kinemathek.de does not resolve. Main site is Drupal with a live JSON:API (/jsonapi) but it only exposes editorial content types (node--page/exhibition/blog/program, media--image, taxonomy--object_category) — NOT a collection-object resource. Collection data lives on sammlungen.deutsche-kinemathek.de (FlowWorks FlowCenter 'graphite edition' DAM), whose public SPAs (/recherche/, /kaenguruh/) call a proprietary WebSocket API wss://.../flws/socket (subprotocol 'felib'; init via GET /flow2/api/initws). Actions incl. clipsbyfulltext/clipbyid/clipsbyfields/sdkobjekte/sdkwerke/fileget. No REST/GraphQL/IIIF/eMuseum/Solr; no static JSON export (kaenguruh manifest.json = CRA PWA manifest). Library OPAC is Koha (deutsche-kinemathek.bsz-bw.de) = bibliographic, out of scope.
probe_summary: Located the real collection backend (FlowCenter DAM WebSocket) and confirmed it answers unauthenticated. clipsbyfulltext returned live records and ONE media-bearing record (252210) yielded a 600dpi 8859x5316 master TIF + a 1200x719 on-demand JPEG via mfc/thumbnail.cgi (>=600px download proven). BUT the catalogue is moving-image film distribution, flat-art search terms returned 0-1 hits with no attached images, the flat-art collections are static editorial microsites without an enumerable object API, the full DAM is login-gated, and the WS is severely rate-limited (intermittent successes, ~90% timeouts). No viable in-scope flat-art catalogue.

exhibitions_entry.name: Deutsche Kinemathek – Museum für Film und Fernsehen
exhibitions_entry.description: Germany's national museum of film and television, located in the Filmhaus at Potsdamer Platz in Berlin. Founded on the collection of Gerhard Lamprecht, it preserves hundreds of thousands of objects spanning film and TV history — films, scripts, photographs, posters, costumes and film technology — and is home to the renowned Marlene Dietrich Collection Berlin, alongside the estates of Josef Fenneker, Ken Adam, Werner Herzog and others.
exhibitions_entry.description_ko: 베를린 포츠담 광장의 필름하우스에 자리한 독일의 국립 영화·텔레비전 박물관이다. 영화사가 게르하르트 람프레히트의 수집품을 바탕으로 출발했으며, 영화와 텔레비전의 역사를 아우르는 수십만 점의 자료 — 필름, 시나리오, 사진, 포스터, 의상, 영사 장비 — 를 소장하고 있다. 마를레네 디트리히 컬렉션 베를린을 비롯해 요제프 페네커, 켄 애덤, 베르너 헤어초크 등의 유품 아카이브로도 잘 알려져 있다.

notes: Start URL https://www.deutsche-kinemathek.de/en/collections-archives/collections 404s (as hinted). Current paths: collections overview = /en/online/digital-collection; digital collection portal = /en/online/sammlung-digital. The 'Rechercheportal' (search portal) is https://sammlungen.deutsche-kinemathek.de/recherche/ (React SPA). Reusable technical recipe if revisited: GET https://sammlungen.deutsche-kinemathek.de/flow2/api/initws -> {wsurl:'wss://.../flws/socket', wsprotocols:['felib']}; open WS with subprotocol 'felib' + Origin header; send {action:'usercurrent',params:{}} first; then {action:'clipsbyfulltext',params:{query,limit,offset,add}} (responses can stall/throttle — pace one socket, small limits ~10, expect frequent timeouts). Media: record.mainthumbnail.url + record.mediafiles[].url (mfc/medialink master) ; mfc/thumbnail.cgi?file=<jpgpath>&width=&height= resizes on demand. Object catalogue actions sdkobjekte/sdkwerke/sdkwerkbyid exist but need a 'fields' param (sdkwerke error: 'params.fields is not iterable') and were not enumerable in probe. RECONSIDER only if the museum exposes a non-throttled object API or a static flat-art export, or if scope expands to scrape the small curated Dietrich/Fenneker/Ken-Adam editorial galleries by hand. Coordinates = Filmhaus, Potsdamer Str. 2, 10785 Berlin.
